Top-left plot (labeled M = 0 [?]): red curve is a flat horizontal line (underfit). Top-right plot (labeled M = 1 [?]): red curve is a straight sloped line (underfit). Bottom-left plot (labeled M = 3 [?]): red curve is a smooth cubic-like curve closely following the green curve (good fit). Bottom-right plot (labeled M = 9 [?]): red curve is a highly wiggly curve passing through every blue dot (overfit). Axes have small tick marks but no readable numeric labels.
